title: 星展CEO谈AI安全：护栏与控制平面，如何防范模型风险？
speaker: Tan Su Shan

segments.en: There are institutions out there which have said no to Chinese models because of the risk involved. Does that keep you up at night?
segments.zh: 有些机构因风险而拒绝中国模型，这会让你夜不能寐吗？

segments.en: It's on whoever uses them to put the right guard rails out. And we've got all our guard rails.
segments.zh: 使用方有责任设置正确的护栏，我们已设置所有护栏。

segments.en: And as I said, we're creating an AI harness, an AI control plane so that we have the observability, accountability, and we have to patch.
segments.zh: 如我所说，我们正在创建AI工具和控制平面，以实现可观测性、问责制，并需要打补丁。

segments.en: It's upon us right now to do that and do the right thing by our customers. So we're all over this cybersecurity and the use of AI to counter AI, top of mind.
segments.zh: 我们现在有责任这样做，为客户做正确的事。我们高度重视网络安全和以AI对抗AI。

segments.en: The three to five years down the road, how do you see AI? I guess reshaping DBS. I think it will fundamentally change the way we work, right?
segments.zh: 未来三到五年，AI将如何重塑星展？我认为它将从根本上改变我们的工作方式。

segments.en: And it means that workflows and work processes that we're used to in a vertical way will become more horizontal.
segments.zh: 这意味着我们习惯的垂直工作流程将变得更加水平化。

segments.en: It means that there will be things that, you know, as an organization, you'll have to own that that's what I meant by sovereign code or owning your own code.
segments.zh: 这意味着作为组织，你必须拥有某些东西，这就是我所说的主权代码或拥有自己的代码。

segments.en: There'll be things that you can buy. It's faster and easier and that's fine. And things you own and you build.
segments.zh: 有些东西可以购买，更快更容易，没问题。有些东西你需要自己拥有和构建。

segments.en: But what is important? What is the mode? What are your modes to keep you ahead? Because tech in itself is not a differentiator.
segments.zh: 但重要的是什么？模式是什么？哪些模式让你保持领先？因为技术本身不是差异化因素。

segments.en: Your own differentiation is number one, your customer data. How well you use it? Number two, your culture, whether you have a culture of innovation, are you fast, are you nimble?
segments.zh: 你的差异化首先是客户数据，你如何用好它？其次是文化，是否有创新文化，是否快速敏捷？
